notes: לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ → *his lovingkindness endureth for ever*: *endureth* is the construction's continuance copula and joins the predicate לְ, headed on *for* (rule 20's own example; rule 49). ASV italic corroborates and decides nothing (rule 7).

דֹּר וָדֹר → *all generations*: distributive repetition, first דֹּר takes the noun with its supplied quantifier (rule 22 distributive paragraph, rule 15); waw and second דֹּר unrepresented. Gapped copula in the second colon is not written by the ASV, so nothing is placed.
